graph.name: Sanofi Darwin - Secure Data Analytics Portal for Data Scientists (Real World Evidence)
graph.categories: Analytics, Machine Learning, Data Lake, Healthcare, Security
graph.notes: Sanofi and partner Teamwork built a secure self-service data science portal on AWS for the Darwin Real World Evidence ecosystem. A static S3 website behind CloudFront authenticates users via Cognito federated with Sanofi SSO. API Gateway and DynamoDB provide traceability. Service Catalog provisions per-user RStudio and SageMaker environments. Lambda functions call Translate and Comprehend / Comprehend Medical. Sensitive data stays in the S3 data lake and per-user home buckets and cannot be downloaded to workstations. In production since early August; grew from 5-10 beta testers to 30-40 users within 2-3 weeks. Lake Formation is being considered for the future.

nodes.name: CloudFront
nodes.notes: Distribution in front of the static website; used to reduce costs and holds the certificate. Entry point for users.

nodes.name: Cognito
nodes.notes: Identifies portal users through identity federation with the Sanofi SSO.

nodes.name: S3 — Static Web App
nodes.notes: Static website (S3 static website feature) hosting the Data Analytics portal.

nodes.name: S3 — Data Lake
nodes.notes: Data lake holding highly sensitive data. Users extract data into their own home-user S3 bucket; data is segregated, encrypted, audited, accessible only per predefined rights, and cannot be downloaded to a workstation.

nodes.name: ApiGateway
nodes.notes: Dynamic part of the portal, used to implement data traceability.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: User activity log: stores user metadata and all actions performed on the Data Analytics portal; strong traceability of users and of each dataset used.

nodes.name: ServiceCatalog
nodes.notes: Portfolio of products (SageMaker and RStudio) built via CloudFormation, offered to users from the portal; repeatable deployments with a focus on security and user isolation.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Lambda functions that call Translate and Comprehend / Comprehend Medical directly through the SDK.

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: RStudio (proprietary app) provisioned per user as a Service Catalog product.

nodes.name: SageMaker
nodes.notes: Per-user SageMaker notebooks, encrypted, with a 100 GB disk for data, and traced; each user only accesses the dataset they are entitled to.

nodes.name: Translate
nodes.notes: Bulk translation of raw files from an automatically detected language to a target language chosen by the user.

nodes.name: Comprehend
nodes.notes: Specifically Comprehend Medical: identifies data/metadata inside raw files. Comprehend is also used to auto-detect the source language for translation.

nodes.name: Sanofi SSO
nodes.notes: Sanofi corporate SSO acting as the identity provider federated with Cognito.
